cause: A held-space trackpad drag at a cursor/context boundary returned zero movement and was incorrectly committed as a space on release.
fix: Consume intentional drag displacement beyond the existing14-point threshold on either axis, independent of actual cursor displacement. Preserve normal taps,stationary holds and actual-movement haptics.
limits: Some host contexts expose only the current line (native pasted URL trace: before=abc, after=nil). Trackpad movement is bounded by that supplied context and cannot reconstruct hidden previous lines.
